# Canvas API

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-api.ts from src/api/schema.ts. Do not edit by hand: run `npm run api:gen`. -->

The Canvas API is the programmable surface of the PaperOS desktop: one
object, `paperos`, whose namespaces cover windows, layouts, workspaces,
projects, files, the preview, the console, commands, the camera and events.
Scripts in the **Script** window, plugins and the MCP bridge all use the same
API, and every method returns plain JSON, so results can be logged, stored or
sent to an agent unchanged.

API version: 1. 42 methods in 10 namespaces.

## Where to call it

- **Script window** (New window → Script): the editor's code runs as an async
  function with `paperos` and a capturing `console` in scope, so
  `await paperos.files.read("index.html")` works at the top level.
- **Browser devtools**: `window.paperos` is the same object once the
  desktop has mounted. Try `paperos.windows.list()`.
- **Plugins**: `activate(api)` receives the API plus registration helpers
  (see `src/plugins/types.ts`).
- **MCP agents**: `tools/paperos-mcp` exposes every method that takes no
  callback as an MCP tool named `<namespace>_<method>` (see
  [`docs/MCP.md`](MCP.md)).

Scripts and plugins run **inside the page with the page's privileges**, like
code pasted into the devtools. Only run code you trust.

## Conventions

- Window ids are tldraw shape ids (`shape:...`); the prefix may be omitted.
- Positions and sizes are in page units (canvas pixels at zoom 1). Windows
  are at least 240 × 160.
- File paths are relative to the project root, POSIX style, no leading slash
  (a leading slash is tolerated). File methods act on the **active** project;
  `projects.open()` switches it.
- Methods that change state are synchronous unless they touch files or
  projects, which return promises.
- Bad input throws an `Error` with a readable message; nothing is silently
  ignored.
- Object-style calls (`invokeTool`, MCP) pass one object whose keys are the
  parameter names. A method whose only parameter is an options object takes
  that object directly: `windows_create {"kind": "note"}`.

## Events

`paperos.events.on(name, callback)` subscribes (`"*"` for everything);
`events.poll(since)` returns the last 200 events for callers that cannot hold
a callback (the MCP bridge). Each event is `{seq, name, time, payload}`.

| Event             | Payload                                                                  |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `window.created`  | `{id, kind, title}`                                                      |
| `window.closed`   | `{id, kind, title}`                                                      |
| `window.focused`  | `{id, kind, title}`                                                      |
| `layout.changed`  | `{preset, tiled: string[]}`                                              |
| `file.changed`    | `{project, path, kind: 'write' \| 'mkdir' \| 'rename' \| 'delete', to?}` |
| `command.run`     | `{id}`                                                                   |
| `project.changed` | `{id, name}`                                                             |

(7 events.)

## Examples

```js
// Tile everything in a grid and zoom to it
paperos.layout.apply("grid");
paperos.canvas.zoomTo();

// Open every JavaScript file of the project
const files = await paperos.files.list();
for (const f of files.filter((f) => f.path.endsWith(".js"))) {
  paperos.files.open(f.path);
}

// One note per file, then a screenshot
for (const f of files) {
  paperos.windows.create({ kind: "note", title: f.path, content: f.path });
}
const shot = await paperos.canvas.screenshot();
console.log(shot.width, shot.height);

// React to windows being created
const off = paperos.events.on("window.created", (e) => console.log(e.payload));
```

## Reference

### `windows`

#### `windows.list`

```ts
paperos.windows.list();
```

Every window on the current page, in z-order (bottom first).

Returns `WindowInfo {id, kind, title, content, x, y, w, h, tiled, focused}[]`. read-only · MCP tool `windows_list`.

#### `windows.get`

```ts
paperos.windows.get(id: string)
```

One window by id.

Returns `WindowInfo {id, kind, title, content, x, y, w, h, tiled, focused} or null`. read-only · MCP tool `windows_get`.

| Parameter | Required | Type     | Description                             |
| --------- | -------- | -------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `id`      | yes      | `string` | Window id (as returned by windows.list) |

#### `windows.create`

```ts
paperos.windows.create(options: {kind: string, title?: string, content?: string, rect?: {x?: number, y?: number, w?: number, h?: number}, tiled?: boolean})
```

Creates a window of a registered kind (files, editor, preview, console, markdown, note, script, plugins, agent, or a plugin kind). Without a rect it cascades at the viewport center.

Returns `WindowInfo {id, kind, title, content, x, y, w, h, tiled, focused}`. changes state · MCP tool `windows_create` · object-style call passes the object itself.

| Parameter         | Required | Type                                                                                                                         | Description                                                                                                                   |
| ----------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `options`         | yes      | `{kind: string, title?: string, content?: string, rect?: {x?: number, y?: number, w?: number, h?: number}, tiled?: boolean}` | What to create                                                                                                                |
| `options.kind`    | yes      | `string`                                                                                                                     | Window kind id                                                                                                                |
| `options.title`   | no       | `string`                                                                                                                     | Title bar text                                                                                                                |
| `options.content` | no       | `string`                                                                                                                     | Kind-specific content: note text, script source, a JSON file reference for editors ({"project","path"}), a preview entry path |
| `options.rect`    | no       | `{x?: number, y?: number, w?: number, h?: number}`                                                                           | Position and size in page units                                                                                               |
| `options.tiled`   | no       | `boolean`                                                                                                                    | Add it to the active layout (default false)                                                                                   |

#### `windows.update`

```ts
paperos.windows.update(id: string, patch: {title?: string, content?: string})
```

Changes a window's title and/or content.

Returns `WindowInfo {id, kind, title, content, x, y, w, h, tiled, focused}`. changes state · MCP tool `windows_update`.

| Parameter       | Required | Type                                 | Description                             |
| --------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------- |
| `id`            | yes      | `string`                             | Window id (as returned by windows.list) |
| `patch`         | yes      | `{title?: string, content?: string}` | Fields to change                        |
| `patch.title`   | no       | `string`                             |                                         |
| `patch.content` | no       | `string`                             |                                         |

### `layout`

#### `layout.apply`

```ts
paperos.layout.apply(preset: 'free' | 'columns' | 'grid' | 'bento-1-2' | 'bento-2-1' | 'bento-mosaic' | 'split-tree')
```

Tiles every window with a preset inside the current viewport ('free' floats them all).

Returns `LayoutState {preset, root (layout tree or null), region, tiled: window ids}`. changes state · MCP tool `layout_apply`.

| Parameter | Required | Type                                                                                            | Description   |
| --------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------- |
| `preset`  | yes      | `'free' \| 'columns' \| 'grid' \| 'bento-1-2' \| 'bento-2-1' \| 'bento-mosaic' \| 'split-tree'` | Layout preset |

#### `layout.tile`

```ts
paperos.layout.tile(ids?: string[])
```

Adds windows to the layout (all windows when ids is omitted). Uses the current preset, or columns when none is active.

Returns `LayoutState {preset, root (layout tree or null), region, tiled: window ids}`. changes state · MCP tool `layout_tile`.

| Parameter | Required | Type       | Description                       |
| --------- | -------- | ---------- | --------------------------------- |
| `ids`     | no       | `string[]` | Window ids; omit for every window |

#### `layout.untile`

```ts
paperos.layout.untile(ids?: string[])
```

Floats windows again (every window when ids is omitted, which also clears the layout).

Returns `LayoutState {preset, root (layout tree or null), region, tiled: window ids}`. changes state · MCP tool `layout_untile`.

| Parameter | Required | Type       | Description                       |
| --------- | -------- | ---------- | --------------------------------- |
| `ids`     | no       | `string[]` | Window ids; omit for every window |

#### `layout.split`

```ts
paperos.layout.split(id: string, side: 'left' | 'right' | 'top' | 'bottom', windowId?: string)
```

Tiles a window next to another one (left/right/top/bottom), i3 style. Creates a new note window when windowId is omitted.

Returns `LayoutState {preset, root (layout tree or null), region, tiled: window ids}`. changes state · MCP tool `layout_split`.

| Parameter  | Required | Type                                     | Description                                     |
| ---------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `id`       | yes      | `string`                                 | The window to split                             |
| `side`     | yes      | `'left' \| 'right' \| 'top' \| 'bottom'` | Where the other window goes                     |
| `windowId` | no       | `string`                                 | The window to place there (default: a new note) |

#### `layout.swap`

```ts
paperos.layout.swap(a: string, b: string)
```

Exchanges the places of two tiled windows.

Returns `LayoutState {preset, root (layout tree or null), region, tiled: window ids}`. changes state · MCP tool `layout_swap`.

| Parameter | Required | Type     | Description      |
| --------- | -------- | -------- | ---------------- |
| `a`       | yes      | `string` | First window id  |
| `b`       | yes      | `string` | Second window id |

#### `layout.getTree`

```ts
paperos.layout.getTree();
```

The current layout: preset, tree, region and tiled ids.

Returns `LayoutState {preset, root (layout tree or null), region, tiled: window ids}`. read-only · MCP tool `layout_getTree`.

#### `projects.open`


| `options.scale` | no       | `number`                           | Pixels per page unit (default 0.5) |

### `events`

#### `events.on`

```ts
paperos.events.on(name: 'window.created' | 'window.closed' | 'window.focused' | 'layout.changed' | 'file.changed' | 'command.run' | 'project.changed' | '*', callback: function)
```

Subscribes to an event ('*' for all). The callback gets {name, time, payload}. Returns an unsubscribe function.

Returns `unsubscribe function`. read-only · scripts only (takes a callback).

| Parameter  | Required | Type                                                                                                                                         | Description       |
| ---------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------- |
| `name`     | yes      | `'window.created' \| 'window.closed' \| 'window.focused' \| 'layout.changed' \| 'file.changed' \| 'command.run' \| 'project.changed' \| '*'` | Event name or '*' |
| `callback` | yes      | `function`                                                                                                                                   | function(event)   |

#### `events.list`

```ts
paperos.events.list();
```

The event names that exist.

Returns `string[]`. read-only · MCP tool `events_list`.

#### `events.poll`

```ts
paperos.events.poll(since?: integer)
```

Recent events (the last 200 are kept). Pass the returned cursor to get only newer ones next time.

Returns `{events: {seq, name, time, payload}[], cursor}`. read-only · MCP tool `events_poll`.

| Parameter | Required | Type      | Description                               |
| --------- | -------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `since`   | no       | `integer` | Cursor from the previous call (default 0) |
